purpose: Review a finite Campaign129 catalog against all 151 complete logical definitions and terminal histories, without opening any source row or research value, and admit only a genuinely independent three-session mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_zero_volume_resumption_streak
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign113 already capacity-terminalized the exact suspension/resumption-duration state at an optimistic upper bound of 181 eligible cohorts versus the frozen 200-cohort minimum. Inferring the state from zero-volume daily rows would downgrade source semantics and rescue the same failed mechanism.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_directional_wick_rejection_confirmation_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Directional candle, body and wick variants were explicitly rejected in Campaign009, Campaign012 and Campaign015; Campaign048 terminalized the wick family and rejected serial, entropy and subwindow variants, with Campaign100 preserving that prohibition. A confirmation form is a relabelled retry.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_transaction_price_distribution_overlap
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted one-minute amount and volume snapshot
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Wasserstein, Jensen-Shannon or overlap scores on the same morning/afternoon transaction-price distributions are alternate distribution statistics immediately following Campaign128. Campaign128 froze the dispersion-resolution mechanism and forbade alternative quantiles, support rules, direction, estimators, models, combinations and rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_rolling_market_beta_or_residual_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.source: accepted daily OHLCV and market aggregates
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Rolling beta, residual return, idiosyncratic volatility and market-relative daily states were already exposed and terminal in the Campaign026, Campaign030 and Campaign031 histories. Changing the rolling window or residual summary is a parameter sweep, not a new information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_autocorrelation_or_hurst_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Return serial dependence, time reversal, five-minute variance-ratio, signed-path and direction-dictionary mechanisms already have terminal histories. Choosing another lag, Hurst estimator or aggregation window would continue an exposed estimator sweep.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_library_interaction_pair_or_model
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Complete-library pair, subset, interaction and model searches have terminal histories. Recombining exposed factors after observing their outcomes is forbidden and cannot create an independent prevalue mechanism.

selection.reason: Every finite proposal is an explicit terminal family, a semantic downgrade or rescue, an alternate estimator of the just-exposed Campaign128 mechanism, or a post-exposure combination.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Begin only from a genuinely new prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted point-in-time source; preserve all Campaign129 rejections, the exact 151-definition/140-comparator orders, and the current-listing survivorship limitation.
